motivation: DATA.md: "You get positions and team membership, nothing more". The team of a track is decided by the tracker, and a goalkeeper wears another kit than his team-mates. A reporting-only diagnostic (experiments/possession_v2/stress_roles.py, 11 Nov 13:04-13:33; Metrica games 1-3, one corrupted copy each, frozen release logic) measured what happens IF goalkeeper tracks carry the other team's id: see diagnostic_spell_f1. With both goalkeepers affected the attack directions that possession/features.py derives from the mean x of each team are inverted. Whether the provided tracking has this error is not known and is not looked at.
candidate: possession-v2.10 = possession-v2.9 with possession/keeper.py applied to the tactical tracking that the models see. The noise gate, the broadcast alignment, the registration and the 0.50 m gate keep using the tracking as given, exactly as in v2.9. Goalkeeper track pieces are found from positions and track continuity (nearest tracked player to a goal while play is in the other half; continuation of such a piece) and moved to the team that defends that goal; nothing changes when no piece is found in a slot of the wrong team.
development: Rule and constants were developed on the four DFL training matches (J03WOH, J03WOY, J03WPY, J03WQQ; corrupted copies with simulated errors, four slot layouts) by counting goalkeeper and other positions with a wrong team id before and after the correction, without running a model (work/gk/gk_stats.py, gk_dev.py, gk_diag.py, gk_false.py), and one model check on J03WOH, which is in the training set (gk_check.py: ids correct 0.7392 -> 0.7392, both goalkeepers wrong 0.3251 -> 0.7328).
seen_before_registration: The diagnostic rows above (they include validation matches MET1 and MET2 and reserved MET3, release logic WITHOUT the correction) and the development numbers on training matches. No result of the candidate on a validation or reserved match.

validation.copies: 8 new corrupted copies: possession.degrade, v2 profile (RANGES), seed 10100 + 10 * match_index + j, j = 0, 1

conditions.none: team ids as corrupted (degrade moves players to the other team for 1-6 s at random)
conditions.gk_one: the home goalkeeper's track carries the away team's id for the whole match
conditions.gk_both: both goalkeepers carry the other team's id for the whole match
conditions.gk_part: each goalkeeper carries the other team's id during random stretches of 30-300 s covering 30% of the match (seed 20100 + 100 * condition_index + copy_index)

validation.layout: tracks packed into 46 anonymous slots, 23 per team; a track lost for at most 25 frames returns to its slot (possession/epts_export.pack)

systems.v2_9: noise gate, then the v2.1 or v2.3 path (tactical camera only)
systems.v2_10: the same after possession.keeper.correct_goalkeepers; the noise gate is decided on the tracking as given

validation.models: the validation models (trained on the four training matches only), work/exp_v25.run_path, as in every earlier validation
validation.metric: spellF1 (organisers' possession_metrics) on the provider / proxy labels
validation.runs: 8 copies x 4 conditions x 2 systems; when the correction moves nothing the two systems are the same run
validation.seeds_checked_unused: 10100-10131, 20100-20407 and 30103 occur in no earlier plan, results file, document or script (searched on registration)

gates.G1 neutral with correct ids: condition none: mean(v2_10 - v2_9) >= -0.002 and no copy below -0.005
gates.G2 both goalkeepers: condition gk_both: mean(v2_10) >= mean(v2_9 under condition none) - 0.015
gates.G3 one goalkeeper: condition gk_one: mean(v2_10) >= mean(v2_9 under none) - 0.010 and mean(v2_10 - v2_9) >= +0.008
gates.G4 part of the time: condition gk_part: mean(v2_10) >= mean(v2_9 under none) - 0.010 and mean(v2_10 - v2_9) >= 0

decision_rule: All four gates pass: possession-v2.10 becomes the release (entry point possession.run210, new manifest; possession-v2.9 stays as the next step of the technical ladder). Any gate fails: possession-v2.9 stays the release and the candidate is reported as not selected. The gates are applied once, to all rows.
reported_alongside: every row; share of goalkeeper positions with a wrong id before and after the correction
reserved Metrica game 3, one new copy (seed 30103), the four conditions, once, after the decision (not a gate)
a full-size rehearsal of the entry point on the synthetic provided-like bundle with both goalkeepers exchanged (wiring, not a gate)
limits: The errors are simulated by us; the provided tracking may have none of them or a different kind. The candidate is a safeguard, not a measured improvement on the provided match.
The correction is validated with the tactical camera only; the broadcast path is unchanged by construction.
A goalkeeper who is not tracked at all cannot be corrected.
Fixtures accessed before; the validation matches have been used for every earlier selection.
